newsitem.title: USA: Clinton delighted with tone of Congress meeting.
newsitem.headline: Clinton delighted with tone of Congress meeting.

text.p: White House spokesman Mike McCurry called President Bill Clinton's meeting on Tuesday with the Congressional leadership "productive" and said that Clinton was "delighted" with the tone of the discussion.
"It was, the president said, a uniformly positive meeting," McCurry told reporters, adding he would not rule out the possibility of further such meetings.
"He was delighted with the tone and with the free exchange and with the candor."
